metadata.title: zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol - Remaining Properties Audit Checklist (Stage 2 - Batch 5)
metadata.description: Partial checklist for non-boundary properties. This batch covers remaining edge transitions and subgraph properties including ZKP, cryptographic primitives, and cross-chain flows.

checklist.title: Verify LiquidityManager transfers exact (amount - fee) using SafeERC20
checklist.description: Verify that the unwrap operation transfers precisely (amount - fee) to the user using SafeERC20.safeTransfer, with fee computed correctly from IncentiveLib.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate unwrap() function in LiquidityManager
2. Trace the amount calculation: transferAmount = amount - fee
3. Verify SafeERC20.safeTransfer is used (not raw transfer)
4. Confirm fee calculation uses ceiling rounding (protects protocol)
5. Test edge case: unwrap where amount - fee = 0

executable_checks.assertion: User receives exactly amount - fee
No unchecked transfer findings

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-010-LM-TRANSFERS-UNDERLYING -> Edge EDGE-LM-TRANSFERS-UNDERLYING. Transfer amount computed from input minus fee in same transaction.

checklist.title: Verify Unwrapped event emitted with accurate parameters
checklist.description: Verify that the Unwrapped event is emitted with the correct user address, underlying token, zERC20 token, amount burned, and underlying transferred.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Unwrapped event definition in LiquidityManager
2. Find emit statement in unwrap() function
3. Verify each parameter matches actual values used in transaction
4. Confirm event emitted after state changes (CEI pattern)
5. Test that indexer can reconstruct unwrap history from events

executable_checks.assertion: Event parameters match transaction values

executable_checks.command: Review event emission ordering vs state changes
executable_checks.assertion: Event emitted after all state mutations

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-011-UNWRAP-COMPLETE -> Edge EDGE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE. Event populated from transaction state.

checklist.title: Verify unwrap handles low liquidity by increasing fee (no revert)
checklist.description: Verify that when liquidity is low, the incentive curve increases the unwrap fee to reduce output amount, rather than reverting. This design ensures unwrap always succeeds but with reduced output when liquidity is scarce.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate fee calculation in unwrap() function
2. Verify incentive curve increases fee when liquidity is low
3. Test case: unwrap when liquidity is abundant (low fee)
4. Test case: unwrap when liquidity is scarce (high fee, reduced output)
5. Verify unwrap does NOT revert on low liquidity - fee adjustment handles it

executable_checks.assertion: Unwrap succeeds with higher fee when liquidity is low
Fee correctly increases as liquidity decreases

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-012-UNWRAP-INSUFFICIENT-LIQUIDITY -> Edge EDGE-UNWRAP-INSUFFICIENT-LIQUIDITY. DESIGN: Unwrap does NOT revert on low liquidity. Instead, the incentive curve increases fee to reduce output amount, ensuring the operation always succeeds.

checklist.title: Verify SafeERC20.safeTransfer guarantees user receives tokens
checklist.description: Verify that successful unwrap completion guarantees user receives underlying tokens via SafeERC20.safeTransfer, which reverts on failure.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify SafeERC20 import and usage in LiquidityManager
2. Confirm safeTransfer used (not raw transfer)
3. Test with token that returns false on failure
4. Test with token that reverts on failure
5. Verify no try-catch silently swallows transfer failure

executable_checks.assertion: safeTransfer reverts if underlying transfer fails
SafeERC20 properly used for all transfers

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-013-USER-NOW-HAS-UNDERLYING -> Edge EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-UNDERLYING. SafeERC20.safeTransfer reverts on failure. Success implies transfer complete.

checklist.title: Verify _afterTokenTransfer enforces BN254 constraint on all transfers
checklist.description: Verify that the BN254 scalar field constraint (value <= 2^248-1) is enforced on the recipient's balance after every transfer, including mints and burns.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate _afterTokenTransfer hook in zERC20
2. Verify it checks recipient balance against MAX_VALUE
3. Confirm hook called for transfer, mint, and burn
4. Test transfer that would push recipient over MAX_VALUE
5. Verify teleport() also triggers the hook

executable_checks.assertion: Constraint enforced on transfer, mint, teleport
MAX_VALUE constant matches BN254 scalar field

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-015-ZERC20-VALIDATES-VALUE -> Edge EDGE-ZERC20-VALIDATES-VALUE. BN254 field constraint. _afterTokenTransfer hook called for all transfers including mint/burn.

checklist.title: Verify ValueTooLarge revert triggers correctly
checklist.description: Verify that the custom ValueTooLarge error is thrown when any operation would result in a balance exceeding 2^248-1.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate ValueTooLarge custom error definition
2. Find all locations where it can be triggered
3. Verify the comparison: if (value > MAX_VALUE) revert ValueTooLarge()
4. Test exact boundary: balance = MAX_VALUE (should pass)
5. Test boundary+1: balance = MAX_VALUE + 1 (should revert)

executable_checks.assertion: MAX_VALUE passes, MAX_VALUE+1 reverts
ValueTooLarge() error properly defined

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-016-VALUE-TOO-LARGE -> Edge EDGE-VALUE-TOO-LARGE. Explicit comparison: if (value > MAX_VALUE) revert ValueTooLarge().

checklist.title: Verify atomic balance updates using OpenZeppelin _transfer
checklist.description: Verify that zERC20 balance updates are atomic, updating both sender and recipient balances in the same transaction with checks-effects-interactions pattern.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify zERC20 inherits from OpenZeppelin ERC20
2. Confirm _transfer is not overridden
3. Review OpenZeppelin _transfer for atomic updates
4. Verify no external calls between balance updates
5. Test concurrent transfers don't corrupt state

executable_checks.assertion: Sender and recipient balances update atomically
No reentrancy between balance updates

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-017-ZERC20-UPDATES-BALANCES -> Edge EDGE-ZERC20-UPDATES-BALANCES. OpenZeppelin _transfer is atomic with checks-effects-interactions pattern.

checklist.title: Verify hash chain update is deterministic SHA-256 truncated to 248 bits
checklist.description: Verify that the hash chain is updated deterministically using sha256(hashChain || to || value) truncated to 248 bits on every transfer.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate hash chain update logic in _afterTokenTransfer
2. Verify SHA-256 is used (not keccak256 or other)
3. Confirm encoding: abi.encodePacked(hashChain, to, value)
4. Verify truncation to 248 bits (>> 8 or & mask)
5. Test hash chain matches off-chain computation

executable_checks.assertion: On-chain hash matches off-chain computation

executable_checks.command: Compare hash formula with ZK circuit
executable_checks.assertion: On-chain hash computation matches circuit

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-018-ZERC20-UPDATES-HASH-CHAIN -> Edge EDGE-ZERC20-UPDATES-HASH-CHAIN. SHA-256 with 248-bit truncation. Hash chain computation: sha256(hashChain || to || value).

checklist.title: Verify IndexedTransfer event emitted with monotonic index
checklist.description: Verify that the IndexedTransfer event is emitted for every transfer with a strictly increasing index counter.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate IndexedTransfer event definition
2. Find emit in _afterTokenTransfer hook
3. Verify index++ happens BEFORE emit (post-increment correctness)
4. Test that index never decreases
5. Test that index never skips values

executable_checks.assertion: Index strictly increases with each transfer

executable_checks.command: Verify index storage slot overflow protection
executable_checks.assertion: Index type handles full history

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-019-ZERC20-EMITS-EVENT -> Edge EDGE-ZERC20-EMITS-EVENT. Event emitted in _afterTokenTransfer with index++ ensuring monotonicity.

checklist.title: Verify transfer completion implies all state updates complete
checklist.description: Verify that when transfer() returns successfully, all associated state updates (balance, hash chain, event) have been atomically applied.
detection_procedure: 1. Trace full execution path of transfer()
2. Verify _transfer updates balances
3. Verify _afterTokenTransfer updates hash chain
4. Verify _afterTokenTransfer emits IndexedTransfer
5. Confirm no early returns bypass any step

executable_checks.assertion: Balance, hash, and event all updated on success

executable_checks.command: Review for partial state update scenarios
executable_checks.assertion: No code path skips state updates

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-020-TRANSFER-COMPLETE -> Edge EDGE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE. Atomic transaction ensures all-or-nothing execution.

checklist.title: Verify checkpoint reservation is write-once per index
checklist.description: Verify that reservedHashChains mapping is write-once, preventing modification of previously reserved checkpoints.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate reservedHashChains mapping in Verifier
2. Find all write locations to this mapping
3. Verify require(reservedHashChains[index] == 0) before write
4. Confirm no admin function can modify existing entries
5. Test double-reservation attack

executable_checks.assertion: Second write to same index reverts
Only one write path to reservedHashChains

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-022-VERIFIER-RESERVES-CHECKPOINT -> Edge EDGE-VERIFIER-RESERVES-CHECKPOINT. reservedHashChains mapping is write-once per index.

checklist.title: Verify Nova IVC proof generation requires secret ownership
checklist.description: Verify that the Nova IVC proof generation circuit enforces that only the holder of the secret can generate valid proofs for their transfers via compute_burn_address_from_secret().
detection_procedure: 1. Review Nova circuit public inputs
2. Verify secret-to-address binding via compute_burn_address_from_secret()
3. Confirm public input includes derived address (not raw secret)
4. Test proof generation with wrong secret fails verification
5. Verify circuit cannot accept proof for non-owned transfers

executable_checks.command: Audit Nova circuit constraints for secret binding
executable_checks.assertion: Secret must hash to transfer recipient address
Proof generation fails without correct secret

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-NOVA-GEN-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-NOVA-PROOF-GENERATION. Nova IVC soundness + Poseidon binding. Client-side IVC proof generation integrity.

checklist.title: Verify Nova-to-Groth16 conversion preserves semantic equivalence
checklist.description: Verify that the decider conversion from Nova IVC proof to Groth16 preserves the exact same public inputs and proven statement.
detection_procedure: 1. Review decider public input extraction from IVC
2. Verify same public inputs encoded in Groth16 proof
3. Test: same IVC proof -> consistent Groth16 output
4. Verify on-chain verifier expects same public input structure
5. Check sonobe/ark-groth16 library versions match

executable_checks.assertion: Public inputs preserved exactly

executable_checks.command: Diff IVC public inputs vs Groth16 public inputs
executable_checks.assertion: Semantic equivalence maintained

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-NOVA-TO-GROTH16-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-NOVA-TO-GROTH16. Groth16 soundness. Conversion uses verified sonobe/ark-groth16 libraries.

checklist.title: Verify on-chain root proof verification via IRootDecider
checklist.description: Verify that transfer root proof verification correctly validates the Groth16 ZKP via IRootDecider.verifyOpaqueNovaProof and detects divergent proofs triggering emergency state.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate verifyRoot function in Verifier
2. Verify IRootDecider.verifyOpaqueNovaProof is called
3. Confirm proof passes require() on verification result
4. Test invalid proof -> revert
5. Test divergent proof -> emergency state transition

executable_checks.assertion: Invalid proof causes revert
Divergent proof triggers emergency state

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-VERIFY-ROOT-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-NOVA-PROOF-VERIFICATION. IRootDecider.verifyOpaqueNovaProof implements Groth16 verification.

checklist.title: Verify withdrawal proof verification and public input extraction
checklist.description: Verify that withdrawal proof verification correctly validates Nova or Groth16 proof via the appropriate decider and extracts public inputs for teleport execution.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate teleport() function in Verifier
2. Trace proof verification to withdrawal decider
3. Verify public input extraction matches circuit definition
4. Test invalid proof -> revert (no teleport)
5. Verify extracted values used correctly in mint

executable_checks.assertion: Invalid withdrawal proof causes revert
Extracted recipient and amount match proof

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-WITHDRAW-VERIFY-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-WITHDRAWAL-PROOF-VERIFICATION. CRITICAL: Withdrawal proof soundness. Groth16 soundness (bn254 sub-100-bit security).

checklist.title: Verify incentive curve uses correct rounding direction
checklist.description: Verify that IncentiveLib uses floor rounding for rewards and ceiling rounding for fees to prevent protocol loss.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate IncentiveLib reward calculation
2. Verify floor division for rewards (protects protocol)
3. Locate IncentiveLib fee calculation
4. Verify ceiling division for fees (protects protocol)
5. Fuzz test: sum(rewards) <= expected, sum(fees) >= expected

executable_checks.assertion: Rounding never favors user over protocol
Floor for rewards, ceiling for fees

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-INCENTIVE-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-INCENTIVE-CURVE. IncentiveLib explicitly uses floor for rewards and ceiling for fees.

checklist.title: Verify Hub PoseidonT3 Merkle tree computation
checklist.description: Verify that Hub aggregation correctly computes a PoseidonT3 Merkle tree over registered token roots with circom-compatible configuration.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Hub aggregation Merkle tree logic
2. Verify PoseidonT3 hash function used (not keccak)
3. Confirm tree height = 6 for <= 64 tokens
4. Verify circom-compatible Poseidon parameters
5. Test aggregation matches off-chain computation

executable_checks.assertion: On-chain root matches circom computation

executable_checks.command: Verify PoseidonT3 parameters match circom library
executable_checks.assertion: Parameter consistency with ZK circuits

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-HUB-AGG-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-HUB-AGGREGATION. PoseidonT3 collision resistance. Height-6 tree for <= 64 tokens.

checklist.title: Verify LayerZero message flow validates source EID
checklist.description: Verify that Hub and Verifier _lzReceive implementations validate the source endpoint ID (EID) against the registered peer list before processing any payload.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate _lzReceive in Hub and Verifier
2. Verify source EID validation against peer list
3. Test message from unauthorized EID -> reject
4. Test message from authorized EID -> accept
5. Verify no admin bypass for EID validation

executable_checks.assertion: Unauthorized EID causes revert

executable_checks.command: Review peer registration and validation logic
executable_checks.assertion: No path to bypass EID check

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-LZ-FLOW-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-LAYERZERO-MESSAGE-FLOW. LayerZero guardian supermajority (13/19) provides message integrity.

checklist.title: Verify stealth address unlinkability
checklist.description: Verify that stealth address generation produces cryptographically unlinkable addresses using Poseidon hashing with secret binding and PoW enumeration cost.
detection_procedure: 1. Review stealth address derivation algorithm
2. Verify Poseidon hash binding with user secret
3. Confirm PoW requirement adds enumeration cost
4. Analyze: can observer link stealth address to identity?
5. Test: different secrets -> unlinkable addresses

executable_checks.assertion: Same secret -> same address; different secret -> unlinkable
No observable correlation without secret

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-STEALTH-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-STEALTH-ADDRESS-GENERATION. Poseidon + PoW. Privacy: Stealth address unlinkability.

checklist.title: Verify Poseidon hash collision resistance and circom compatibility
checklist.description: Verify that the Poseidon hash implementation is collision-resistant and uses circom-compatible parameters from the audited light-poseidon library.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify light-poseidon library version and audit status
2. Confirm Poseidon parameters match circom poseidon library
3. Test cross-implementation compatibility (Rust vs circom)
4. Verify no custom parameter modifications
5. Check for known vulnerabilities in library version

executable_checks.assertion: Rust Poseidon matches circom output
Using audited library version

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-POSEIDON-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-POSEIDON-HASH-CIRCUIT. TRUSTED: Poseidon hash function. Uses audited light-poseidon library with circom-compatible parameters.
